return [{json:{...b,internal_token:supplied,original_text,agent_id:b.target_agent||'reception.agent',agent_name:p.name,purpose:p.purpose,tool_allowlist,conversation_id:valid_conversation?conversation_id:'',organization_id,context_endpoint,context_request,rag_endpoint,rag_request}}];
